rationale: Skeleton loaders provide visual scaffolding that matches the actual content layout, reducing cognitive load during data fetching. Research shows skeleton screens improve perceived performance by 5-10% compared to spinners. The current implementation uses centered Spinner components which cause jarring layout shifts when content loads.
problemSolved: All data-loading pages use centered Spinner components with generic 'Loading...' states. For example, dashboard.tsx line 321-324 shows a basic spinner that causes the entire page to be blank during load.
